title: The ongoing urgency of diversity science
title_zh: 多样性科学的持续紧迫性
abstract: Efforts to extinguish DEI provoke questions about the ongoing significance of diversity science. We argue that this evolving context makes such research increasingly pressing, and we pose four questions that this environment both calls for and newly allows research to answer. Such science remains indispensable to society's capacity to manage social difference.
abstract_zh: 消除多样性、公平与包容（DEI）的努力引发了关于多样性科学持续重要性的问题。我们认为，这一不断演变的背景使得此类研究愈发迫切，并提出了四个问题，既是该环境所呼唤的，也是新环境所允许研究回答的。此类科学仍是社会管理社会差异能力不可或缺的组成部分。
